Check a custom family's log-density for AD safety

check_custom_family.Rd

Tapes the family's lpdf on test values and compares the AD gradient against central finite differences. A mismatch usually means the lpdf uses operations the tape cannot see (base matrix()/c() on advectors, branching on parameter values, min/max, clamping).

Usage

check_custom_family(family, y, dpars, aterms = list(), tol = 1e-04)

Arguments

family

A frmtmb_family (from frmtmb_family() / custom_family()).

y

A response vector of test data.

dpars

Named list of numeric test values, one entry per dpar (each of length 1 or length(y)).

aterms

Named list of addition-term values (e.g. trials).

tol

Maximum relative gradient error.

Value

Invisibly TRUE; signals an error on failure.
